name: Sound and mix
description: Use when working on a video's sound: a clean voice first, music under it and ducked when people speak, effects with restraint, and loudness at the platform's target.
verification: Pass or fail comes only from the Editing Studio's checks on the rendered file (QUALITY_GATES); the skill adds no tool, approval or setting.

evals.ask: The background music is too loud in my video
Add some sound effects to the reel
Reduce the noise in the log output
